description: Save or forget a note when the user asks. Save a durable fact, not instructions, task state, private details or facts already in the repository. The same name in the same scope replaces the note.

body.description: Optional Markdown detail for save only; the whole note fits in 4 KiB.

fact.description: For save, one line up to 240 UTF-8 bytes. Omit for forget.

name.description: A lowercase slug for the note.

name: remember
